column2: Hypothetical online survey about restaurant delivery usage and experience in the UK.
QuickBite, MealDash and FoodGo are fictional names used only for this simulated case study.
Adults aged 18-74 who have ordered restaurant delivery within the past 3 months.
Portfolio case study for survey response quality auditing in Python.
Completion, duration, page-level timing, attention check, straight-lining, logical consistency, duplicate-like metadata, range validation and open-text quality.
The raw-data sheet contains no QC labels. Use the Ground Truth sheet only after developing your own audit rules if you want to evaluate them.
